title: 11 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Chronic Hepatitis
intro: Herbal essential oils for chronic hepatitis are a natural remedy that involves the use of highly concentrated plant extracts to treat liver inflammation and damage caused by hepatitis. These oils have shown promising benefits in reducing liver inflammation, improving liver function, and enhancing overall liver health. Some examples of herbal essential oils used to treat chronic hepatitis include turmeric essential oil, which contains curcumin that has potent anti-inflammatory properties; dandelion root essential oil, which promotes liver detoxification and improves bile production; milk thistle essential oil, which protects liver cells from damage and supports liver regeneration; and frankincense essential oil, which has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help reduce liver inflammation. Additionally, peppermint essential oil, eucalyptus essential oil, and ginger essential oil are also used to treat chronic hepatitis due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help reduce liver inflammation and improve overall liver health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Silybum marianum essential oils, also known as milk thistle oil, have been widely studied for their potential in treating chronic hepatitis, particularly liver damage caused by viral infections and toxins. The silymarin complex, a bioactive constituent of Silybum marianum, has been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties, helping to repair and regenerate liver cells. By inhibiting lipid peroxidation and modulating the immune response, silymarin helps to reduce liver inflammation and oxidative stress, promoting liver health and function. The benefits of using Silybum marianum essential oils to treat chronic hepatitis include improved liver function, reduced liver enzyme levels, and enhanced overall well-being, making it a promising natural remedy for this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association", Silybum marianum essential oils, specifically the ethanolic seed extracts, showed significant potential in relieving chronic hepatitis by decreasing liver enzymes and increasing glutathione levels.

These constituents help to reduce liver inflammation, scarring, and fibrosis, ultimately leading to improved liver function and overall health. The benefits of using Curcuma longa essential oils to treat chronic hepatitis include reduced liver enzyme levels, improved liver histology, and enhanced overall quality of life.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", Curcuma longa essential oils may have beneficial effects on cirrhosis, specifically showing improvements in alkaline phosphatase (ALP), bilirubin, prothrombin time (PT), and the international normalized ratio (INR), based on one study that included 4 patients.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", Glycyrrhiza glabra essential oils, specifically derived compounds such as glycyrrhizin, have been shown to reduce hepatocellular damage in chronic hepatitis B and C, and even reduce the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma in hepatitis C virus-induced cirrhosis.
